skill.name: performance-monitor
skill.description: Creates SEO and GEO performance reports and alert configurations for domains. It covers traffic, rankings, AI visibility, authority, backlinks, content, thresholds, and response plans.
skill.summary: Builds SEO and GEO performance dashboards, reports, and alert plans.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code spans, fixed repository links, and SEO terminology such as indexation and schema. One confirmed risk remains: the measurement loop instructs the agent to run a local Python ledger command from CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT. No evidence of prompt injection, credential exfiltration, or malicious intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Local command execution in the measurement loop
remediation.suggestion: Make the ledger command optional, require explicit user approval, and document the exact trusted script before execution.
Validate CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT and ensure the ledger script is bundled or pinned before referencing it in instructions.
Sanitize the topic segment to a safe slug before saving under memory/monitoring.

content.value_statement: SEO teams need reliable reports and alerts across traffic, rankings, content, authority, and AI visibility. This skill turns metric inputs into dashboards, threshold plans, response actions, and reusable monitoring summaries.
actual_capabilities: Creates SEO and GEO reports for traffic, rankings, authority, backlinks, content, and AI visibility.
Configures alert triggers, thresholds, priorities, response plans, delivery channels, and cooldown rules.
Labels metrics as Measured, User-provided, or Estimated and marks missing values as not evaluated.
Uses KPI definitions, benchmarks, period comparisons, and readback windows to explain metric movement.
Produces executive, marketing, technical, and client-facing report structures.
Creates optional handoff summaries for memory/monitoring after user confirmation.
limitations: It does not compute CITE or CORE-EEAT scores; it only reports existing results.
Measured reports require connected tools or user-provided analytics, search, ranking, and backlink data.
It is not designed for raw position-by-position rank deltas.
Alert outputs are configuration plans unless external monitoring tools implement them.

use_cases.title: Monthly SEO Review
use_cases.description: Create a period-over-period report with wins, risks, action owners, and missing data clearly marked.

use_cases.title: Executive Performance Brief
use_cases.description: Summarize business impact, ROI, traffic movement, authority, and AI visibility for leadership decisions.

use_cases.title: Technical Alert Planning
use_cases.description: Define thresholds, response times, routing, and first checks for ranking, crawl, index, and site health issues.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Performance Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner report request with a known domain and period.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an SEO performance report for example.com for last month. Compare it with the prior month and mark missing data.

prompt_templates.title: Build GEO Visibility Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate report focused on AI visibility.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a GEO visibility report for example.com. Include AI citations, topic coverage, citation losses, and recommended follow-up actions.

prompt_templates.title: Configure Ranking Drop Alerts
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced alert setup for priority keywords.
prompt_templates.prompt: Set up ranking drop alerts for my top 20 keywords. Use measured baselines when available and include priorities, routing, and response plans.

prompt_templates.title: Design Full Monitoring System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced combined report and alert workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a quarterly SEO and GEO dashboard, then define alert thresholds for traffic, rankings, backlinks, technical health, competitors, and AI citations.

output_examples.input: Create a monthly SEO performance report for a SaaS domain.
output_examples.output: A stakeholder report with metric tables, traffic and ranking deltas, AI citation status, authority trends, risks, owners, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Set alerts for ranking drops and traffic crashes.
output_examples.output: An alert plan with trigger names, warning and critical thresholds, response times, delivery routing, cooldowns, and weekly review rules.

output_examples.input: Prepare a technical SEO health report for engineering.
output_examples.output: A technical summary covering crawl, indexation, Core Web Vitals, errors, schema status, owners, deadlines, and evidence quality.

best_practices: Provide the domain, reporting period, comparison period, audience, and available data sources before running the skill.
Treat every metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated, and never present estimates as measured facts.
Tune alert thresholds from historical baselines and normal volatility before using default values.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill to invent missing analytics, ranking, backlink, or AI visibility numbers.
Do not use it to compute CITE or CORE-EEAT scores that another auditor must produce.
Do not configure alerts for categories the user did not request or approve.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates SEO and GEO performance reports, dashboards, alert plans, response plans, and monitoring handoff summaries.

faq.question: Does it need connected analytics tools?
faq.answer: Connected tools help produce measured values. Without them, the skill asks for exports, baselines, or user-provided data.

faq.question: Can it monitor AI search visibility?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes GEO and AI visibility sections for citations, answer coverage, citation losses, and topic gaps.

faq.question: Does it compute authority or content quality scores?
faq.answer: No. It reports CITE and CORE-EEAT results only when another auditor has already produced them.

faq.question: How are alert thresholds chosen?
faq.answer: The skill prefers measured baselines and normal volatility. It can use default thresholds when labeled as estimated.

faq.question: Is it suitable for raw rank tracking?
faq.answer: No. Use a dedicated rank tracker for position-by-position ranking deltas.
